meta.name: biopython
meta.description: Comprehensive molecular biology toolkit. Use for sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), phylogenetics, and programmatic NCBI/PubMed access (Bio.Entrez). Best for batch processing, custom bioinformatics pipelines, BLAST automation. For quick lookups use gget; for multi-service integration use bioservices.

copy.tagline: 处理分子生物学序列和自动分析生物信息数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理生物信息学数据，需要自动化分析流程。
copy.tagline_en: Manipulate molecular sequences and automate bioinformatics analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly work with bioinformatics data and need automated analysis pipelines.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调用 Biopython 这个 Python 库来处理生物信息任务:读写 FASTA、GenBank、PDB 等文件,操作 DNA/RNA/蛋白质序列,做序列比对、BLAST 搜索、构建进化树,还能用 Bio.Entrez 访问 NCBI 数据库。
howto.when: 当你的任务涉及生物序列处理、生物文件解析(如 FASTA/GenBank/PDB),或需要通过 NCBI/BLAST 做查询时触发。

say.text: 把 sequences.fasta 里的所有序列转换成 GenBank 格式。
say.note: 会用 SeqIO 读取并写出转换结果。

say.text: 用 Bio.Entrez 搜索 PubMed 中关于 CRISPR 的论文。
say.note: 会调用 Entrez.esearch 并返回命中数量。

say.text: 对这两条序列做全局比对,给出比对结果和得分。
say.note: 会用 PairwiseAligner 完成全局比对。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use Biopython, a Python library, for bioinformatics tasks: reading/writing FASTA, GenBank, PDB files; manipulating DNA/RNA/protein sequences; performing alignments, BLAST searches, building phylogenetic trees; and accessing NCBI databases via Bio.Entrez.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task involves biological sequence handling, biological file parsing (e.g., FASTA/GenBank/PDB), or NCBI/BLAST queries.

say_en.text: Convert all sequences in sequences.fasta to GenBank format.
say_en.note: Uses SeqIO to read and write the conversion.

say_en.text: Search PubMed for papers about CRISPR using Bio.Entrez.
say_en.note: Calls Entrez.esearch and returns the hit count.

say_en.text: Perform a global alignment of these two sequences and show the score.
